title: Chief Martial Law Administrator Regulation 1979 No 44

sections.shortTitle: Chief Martial Law Administrator Regulation 1979 No 44
sections.section: RGLN. - Chief Martial Law Administrator Regulation 1979, No. 44
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
By
CHIEF MARTIAL LAW
ADMINISTRATOR
No. 44
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th January 1979]
1. This Martial Law Regulation shall come into
force-at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the fifth day of July
1977.
2. In Martial Law Regulation No. 31-
(1) in paragraph (2),--
(a) in sub-paragraph 1,-
(i) after the words "Commission of
Inquiry", the words "or a Military Court" shall be inserted; and
(ii) after the word "Regulation", the words
"or any other law .for the time being in force" shall be inserted;
and
(b) in sub-paragraph (2), after the words
"Commission of Inquiry", the words "or Military Court"
shall be inserted;
(2) in paragraph 3,-
(a) after the words "Commission of
Inquiry", occurring for the first time, the words "or a Military
Court" shall be inserted; and
(b) after the words "Commission of
Inquiry", occurring for the second time, the words "or Military
Court" shall be inserted.
